questions.title: Standout Player
questions.description: Who shone this session? Vote for the player who stood out in combat, roleplay, creativity, or a memorable moment.

questions.title: For the Team!
questions.description: Who did something for the good of the group, even when it was not the best choice for their own character?

questions.title: Unexpected!
questions.description: Did it go wrong? Did it go right? Either way, it was hilarious! Vote for the star of the session’s funniest disaster.

givePointReasons.title: On Time
givePointReasons.description: Arrived on time and ready to play. The GM is proud!

givePointReasons.title: Great Participation
givePointReasons.description: Participated, interacted, and helped make the session happen. Directly or indirectly, the GM felt you stood out today.

givePointReasons.title: Session Recap!
givePointReasons.description: Helped everyone remember the previous session, gave a recap, or actively joined the discussion to get the group back on track.

redeemBenefits.name: Twist of Fate
redeemBenefits.description: Immediately after a d20 rolls a natural 1 or natural 20, reverse the result: a 1 becomes a 20 and a 20 becomes a 1. You may use this on one of your own rolls or on an enemy’s attack roll against a party member.

redeemBenefits.name: Heroic Moment
redeemBenefits.description: After failing a saving throw, turn the failure into a success. Cannot be used on death saving throws.

redeemBenefits.name: RE-ROLL!
redeemBenefits.description: After seeing the result of a roll, roll the same die again. You must use the new result, even if it is worse.

redeemBenefits.name: Not This Time!
redeemBenefits.description: After a creature hits you with an attack, but before damage is rolled, force it to reroll its attack roll. The new result must be used.

redeemBenefits.name: ADVANTAGE!
redeemBenefits.description: I say two dice are better than one! Make your next d20 roll with advantage. You must declare this before rolling.

redeemBenefits.name: PLUS FIVE!!
redeemBenefits.description: Add +5 to your next d20 roll. You must declare this before rolling.

redeemBenefits.name: Not Yet!
redeemBenefits.description: When making a death saving throw, roll with advantage. You must declare this before rolling.

redeemBenefits.name: Heroic Strike
redeemBenefits.description: After hitting with a weapon attack, but before rolling damage, add one weapon damage die to the roll. This additional die is not multiplied on a critical hit.

redeemBenefits.name: I Can Do That!
redeemBenefits.description: Before making an ability check in which you lack proficiency, treat yourself as proficient for that one roll and add your proficiency bonus.

redeemBenefits.name: Feel Blessed
redeemBenefits.description: Some force decided to lend a hand. Add 1d4 to your next d20 roll. You must declare this before rolling.
